page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 compute-oriented virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1.0 GB memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio. The hardware specification does not include local ephemeral storage, GPU accelerators, or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 1:1 ratio of memory to vCPUs prioritizes multi-core processing density over memory capacity. Because local storage is not attached, persistent network storage must be provisioned separately. This resource balance makes the server suitable for CPU-bound computational jobs, multi-threaded batch processing, stateless web application serving, and software compilation tasks that require processing power without extensive memory overhead.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 virtual server hosted on the KVM hypervisor within the compute-focused instance family. It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance lacks local ephemeral storage, requiring attached network block storage for persistence, and contains no integrated GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With its compute-dense configuration, the server balance favors parallel multi-core CPU execution over memory capacity. This hardware profile is positioned for CPU-bound processing, stateless web serving, software compilation tasks, and parallel batch workloads that do not demand large per-core memory footprints.
